request_state.desc: Primes p dividing x^2 + 3y^2 with gcd(x,y)=1 satisfy (-3/p) = 1, forcing p = 3 or p = 1 mod 3. Since the class group of Q(sqrt(-3)) has class number 1, every prime p = 1 mod 3 splits into principal ideals, hence p = u^2 + 3v^2.
request_state.claim: Algebraic number theory bypasses Fermat residue descent by principal ideal split in Z[omega].
